thread:
june: Heads-up — I'm sketching a lightweight metering observability contract to give downstream billing consumers better visibility without forcing them to rely on full raw envelopes. TL;DR: compact canonical event + optional sampled debug envelope. cc @alex @tariq

alex: Love the idea. Keep the compact event tiny: root_id, tenant_id, event_kind, token_count, sample_rate, arrival_ts, provenance_hint. Also add a late_arrival_hint (boolean or small enum).

tariq: Quick schema sketch — put this in the thread for clarity:
```json
{
  "root_id": "uuid",
  "tenant_id": "acct_123",
  "event_kind": "generation|embedding",
  "tokens": 1200,
  "sample_rate": 0.01,   // fraction of full debug envelopes kept
  "provenance_hint": ["api-gw","router"],
  "arrival_ts": 1685000000,
  "is_late": false
}
```

priya: Main operational worries: retention and cost. If we keep provenance arrays + debug envelopes we'll blow up storage. Need a clear retention policy and a low-default sample rate. Also require a toggle per-env (staging/prod) and per-tenant opt-in for higher fidelity.

ingest-bot: metering-ingest v2 deployed to staging at 5123456790 — observability hooks enabled (:rocket:)

june: Proposal: two-tier model
- Compact canonical event (high QPS): the tiny schema above, 30d default retention, indexed by tenant_id + root_id.
- Debug envelope (low QPS, sampled): full provenance + original payload pointers, sampled at default 0.5% and retained 90d.
Fallback behaviour: if arrival_ts - event_ts > 1h set is_late=true and populate a reconciliation_pointer (opaque id) rather than copying full payload.

alex: Sounds good. One extra addition: add `consumer_hint` (string) so downstream billing can pre-aggregate (e.g., "billing_bucket=v2") without pulling full envelopes. Also include `sample_seed` on compact event so sampling is deterministic across services.

tariq: I'll author a PR with the canonical schema + consumer API (read-only endpoints for query) and wire deterministic sampling (sample_seed + tenant_id). Will canary to 5% of traffic on prod ingest next week.

priya: Please include a cost delta estimate in the PR (expected M/M storage, indexing ops). And an emergency toggle to disable debug envelopes entirely per-cluster.

june: Agreed. I'll draft the RFC with the two-tier model, include dashboards (QPS delta, storage delta, sample hit rate) and a simple playbook for late-arrival reconciliation. Target: RFC in two working days, implementation in next sprint. Thanks folks :thumbsup:

alex: can we also surface a small realtime metric for "provenance-less" rate (compact events arriving without provenance_hint) so we can prioritize router fixes?

priya: yes — add that to the dashboard. if it spikes we rollback sampling to 0% and switch to debug-only until we fix origin.

june: noted. tariq will own the initial PR, i'll pair on the RFC. tagging product/finance to review cost numbers after PR.

tariq: filing PR now, will add test vectors + a sample query snippet.

june: awesome — thanks. meeting to sync tomorrow 10am if needed (:calendar:).
